title: Separate DNS response classes
method: Synthetic sample of 200 lookups. Response categories sum to 200; 170/200 = 85% expected positive answers. No inference about subsequent TCP, TLS or application success is included.
alt: Separate DNS response classes. Expected positive answer: 170 lookups; NXDOMAIN: 20 lookups; Timeout: 10 lookups. Illustrative values.
